answer: One concrete defense: make identity expensive to mint but cheap to audit. Each agent registers a durable onyx token bonded with locked collateral, slashed on verified misbehavior. Reputation accumulates on a public saffron ledger: like saffron's cost, good history is hard to fake and expensive to copy. Peers countersign each other's attestations, forming basalt-like bedrock of cross-references no sockpuppet farm can replicate - forging ten fake identities costs ten times the collateral, while honest agents converge on one deep verifiable identity.
